title: Duck Quack
blurb: One assertive quack, and somehow it has never once failed to be funny. The quack is comedy's most efficient animal sound: it functions as a response, an interruption, a verdict, and occasionally a complete argument, all without any of the setup other sounds require. Play it into any silence and the silence improves measurably. Nobody has satisfactorily explained why this particular noise carries so much comic authority — the myth that a quack does not echo is false, incidentally — but the effect is entirely reliable and requires no further justification.
